text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey is finally heading into the 
Arima Kinen. I want to cheer her on with 
all my might—
choice_data_list: (What might be of help to Journey is...)

text_block_list.text:
An idea suddenly comes to mind. Christmas 
is right around the corner... In that 
case, how about throwing a party just for 
her—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—So. Are you saying... you will be the 
host?

Dream Journey seems very relaxed when 
surrounded by her inner circle— her 
cherished loved ones.
choice_data_list: I wanted to call someone dear to her...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Cease your overly familiar tone. Simply 
present your offering.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Don't just stand there dazed. —Here's the 
proposal.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The guests, the food, the venue, the 
schedule... I shall review them to see if 
they are worthy of my elder sister.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Bring it to me at once.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Exclude the bingo tournament. My elder 
sister will not find enjoyment in it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
No hotel for the venue, either. Inside the 
academy will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The present is... an old fountain pen, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
My sister values efficiency. She would 
never use something like that.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: She seems to really like it lately.

text_block_list.text:
Lately, Dream Journey has been doing more 
writing by hand. It seems she's been 
inspired by her fan letters.
choice_data_list: I... think they'll definitely use it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I see.

And so, making preparations while getting 
advice from Orfevre... Christmas Day 
finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —This is...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Journey! Wild boar piglet, chestnut 
piglet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Whatever is that?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "*Ahem*. Merry Christmas, Journey-san."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...That's enough with the polite 
greetings. Let's hurry up and toast!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We get to play, right? ...Give me a real 
thrill.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Elder Sister. Enjoy yourself to the 
fullest tonight.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Orfe. You?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: No. That one over there did a fine job.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You should show her some appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You prepared all this for me, didn't you? 
Even inviting such wonderful guests...
choice_data_list: All the guests aren't here yet.
All the guests aren't here yet.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh my...

Right then, a knock sounded at the door. 
Upon seeing the two people who walked 
in... Dream Journey's face broke into a 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hello. I am Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You must be Journey-san and Orfe-san's... 
parents, correct? I have been so looking 
forward to meeting you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“—'Sup. It's Golshi-chan. Here, a little 
token of our newfound friendship... 
enjoy.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-I am being quite formal, you see...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What is the matter? Make haste.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Such composed confidence. Is it 
genuine, or merely a bluff...?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Then cry it out. —Cry your defeat.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
――...That just settled it for me. You 
are... a "false king."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Doubt!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Both of you, such incredible intensity...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright, my tuuurn!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Dwahhh...????

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Everyone looks like they're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: No, right here is perfect.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I can just watch everyone having fun...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "This view... It's my everything—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: This is the greatest blessing imaginable.

As the party went on... Dream Journey and 
I saw off her parents, who were heading 
home early.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Shall we head back, then?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, before that. There is something I 
would like to ask.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: How is it? Are you having a good time?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: A Christmas night.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, that's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Because you, too... are right there."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That's right. Fufu...

On the way back to the trainer's office, I 
suddenly noticed... her perfume smelled 
stronger than usual. When I lightly 
brought it up—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I reapplied it just a moment ago... 
Perhaps I sprayed a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It seems I was unexpectedly carried away 
by the party mood.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If I made you feel uncomfortable, I 
sincerely apologize.
choice_data_list: No... It smells really nice, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Do you like it?

Told that, I think about it. In the past, 
there were times I recalled it with a 
touch of fear... But now, it's a scent 
that naturally stays by my side.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Close your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Please... hold out your hand.

Dream Journey stares intently at me. In 
the dim light, I can't read her 
expression... For the first time in a 
while, I feel a chill run down my spine.

—I gently close my eyes. Reaching out a 
hand, I let my body relax. It is my way of 
showing... that I trust her completely.
choice_data_list:
(Not out of subservience, but out of 
trust.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Good girl.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then.

Something icy-cold touches my wrist. 
Following a soft *pssst* sound... I catch 
a whiff of that familiar scent nearby.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll give it to you just as it is.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I never imagined the day would come where 
I'd be giving you this gift..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fragrance is... very important, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Normally, there is nothing binding you 
and me together."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, right now... I am clad in the 
very same thing.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A thick, heavy scent... reminiscent of 
"blood"—
